name: Amino acid
oneLine: A building block of proteins. Life uses twenty kinds.
howItWorks: Each amino acid has the same backbone and a different side piece. The side piece can be oily, charged or small. Strung together, they fold into proteins.
deeper: In 1952 Miller and Urey sparked a gas mixture and made amino acids in a flask. Amino acids have also been found in meteorites.
sizeComparison: a 100,000th the width of a hair
simplification: We show a handful of shapes for twenty real kinds.
